provenance: Original synthetic LiquidBench Milestone 6 development fixture; not training or held-out data.
runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid with supplied hashes only; or static schema/reference contracts. No Shopify service emulation.
prompt: Modify sections/notice-link.liquid to append an optional a after the existing p. section.id,heading,body are strings; show_link boolean; url null or a relative-path string; label null/string. Emit the a only when show_link is true and ASCII-trimmed url nonempty. Its only attribute is href equal to trimmed url; text is label (no trimming), default Details if null/empty. Preserve the existing section/h2/p structure, text and escaping. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/notice-link.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
